input_files.description: List of input .lz files or directories to process. If empty, reads from stdin/stdout behavior is implied by other flags or script logic needs adjustment, but typically lziprecover needs files. Default empty list implies user must populate.

output_dir.description: Directory to place output files. Corresponds to --output.

force.description: Overwrite existing output files. Corresponds to --force.

fec_level.description: FEC fragmentation level (0-9) or specific FEC spec. Corresponds to --fec-level or 0..9 flag.

threads.description: Number of threads for FEC create. Corresponds to --threads.

block_size.description: FEC block size in bytes. Corresponds to --block-size.

stdout.description: Write to standard output. Corresponds to --stdout.

decompress.description: Decompress and test integrity. Corresponds to --decompress.

test_mode.description: Test compressed file integrity. Corresponds to --test.

list_files.description: Print uncompressed file sizes. Corresponds to --list.

merge.description: Repair errors using several copies. Corresponds to --merge.

byte_repair.description: Try to repair a corrupt byte. Corresponds to --byte-repair.

trailing_error.description: Exit with error if trailing data exists. Corresponds to --trailing-error.

alone_to_lz.description: Convert lzma-alone files to lzip format. Corresponds to --alone-to-lz.

lzip_name.description: Name of lzip executable for --reproduce. Corresponds to --lzip-name.

lzip_level.description: Lzip level for --reproduce (N, a, m[N]). Corresponds to --lzip-level.

fec_mode.description: FEC mode (create, repair, test, list). Corresponds to --fec mode argument.

fec_file.description: Path to FEC file. Corresponds to --fec-file.

recursive.description: Operate recursively on directories. Corresponds to --recursive.

dereference_recursive.description: Recursively follow symbolic links. Corresponds to --dereference-recursive.

range_decompress.description: Decompress byte range n-m. Corresponds to --range-decompress.

remove_spec.description: Remove members/data in place. Corresponds to --remove.

strip_spec.description: Strip members when copying. Corresponds to --strip.

loose_trailing.description: Allow trailing data seeming corrupt header. Corresponds to --loose-trailing.

nonzero_repair.description: Repair in place a nonzero first LZMA byte. Corresponds to --nonzero-repair.
